簡易國勢調査結果表 1925

Kan'i kokusei chōsa kekkahyō (Results of the Simplified Census of Korea), 大正十四年十月一日現在 (as of 1 October 1925), published 1926
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1926 (大正十五年十二月十五日發行)

All tables are transcribed (51 tables, about 636,000 figure cells); the regulations, forms, the account of the census (except its two cost tables), the prose summary and the coloured density map (whose legend is given) are not. The age tables are printed in horizontal bands of ages that run across both pages of a spread and over many spreads: each band is one part of its province's table, its left and right pages joined. Each spread was read once by a Claude Sonnet agent from tight crops, with no second reading. The scan is of low resolution for such dense tables and many figures are clipped by the column rules or the edge of the page: 2,020 cells could not be read and are marked [?]. Printed totals were re-added; those that do not add up are kept as printed and noted in each table. Where a digit was ambiguous between 3 and 8 and only one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted; 82 cells whose digits are damaged or hidden and which are fixed only by printed totals are shown with a blue background (inferred). Place names and characters are given in the forms the book uses (忠淸/忠清, 慶尙, 黃, 齡).
